paragraphs.text: Arkol was a scholar of the Argivian University, author of the prefaces of each chapter in the Gathering Dark and the Eternal Ice .

Arkol attempted to analyze past events through the lens of a distanced historian. However, he made several mistakes and wrong assumptions, such as thinking that Jodah was either a family name, a title, or several different people with the same name, rather than the same immortal man. Arkol also wrongly assumed that Marit Lage was a planeswalker , and that Freyalise was fully human .
